verdict.rationale: Notion advertises workspace-wide search plus AI-powered 'Get answers, instantly—with citations' and MCP search across Notion and connected sources, but a hands-on team user managing tasks/projects explicitly reports 'Search still needs some love,' directly contradicting the fast/accurate claim. missing for 10: independent benchmarking of search speed/accuracy across large workspaces, resolution of the community complaint, and evidence of comments-specific search quality.
